patch_description: This version improves on the previous program in three ways. (1) Faster scoring: the hull area is only recomputed when the moved point could change the hull, and the minimum triangle area is computed with fully vectorized cross products over precomputed index triples. (2) Better search dynamics: after each seed's main annealing run, multiple short reheat cycles (temperature reset, decaying steps) are applied with best-ever fallback, directly implementing the recommended adaptive-restart scheme and escaping greedy-climber traps. (3) Deterministic multi-start over three structured seeds (hexagonal rings, staggered hexagons, jittered grid) with fixed per-seed RNGs, followed by a fine greedy polish targeting vertices of the worst triangles. All randomness is seeded, so results are reproducible.
